A new window functions and frame builders API has been implemented and committed to the branch `feat/window-functions`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Function Helpers & Frame Utilities ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts))**:
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L173), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L177), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L181), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L185), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L193), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L197).
   - **Offset helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L221), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L262), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L303), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L311), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L319).
   - **Aggregate helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L332), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L337), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L342), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L352), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L362).
   - **Frame boundary constants & helpers**: [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L48), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L49), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L50), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L52), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L59), [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L99), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L104).
   - Re-exported from top-level `drizzle-orm` package via [src/sql/functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts).

2. **Constraints Handling**:
   - Numeric positional arguments (including `0`) in `ntile`, `nthValue`, `lag`, `lead`, `preceding`, and `following` are formatted as raw SQL chunks rather than query parameters.
   - `ntile` and `nthValue` reject non-positive integer arguments with error messages referencing the function name and received value.
   - `.window(name, spec)` rejects empty names with errors containing `"non-empty"` and whitespace-only names with errors containing `"whitespace"`.
   - `rows()` and `range()` reject specifications where the `from` boundary is ordered after the `to` boundary, referencing `"from"` in the error message.
   - `preceding()` and `following()` reject negative and non-integer arguments with errors referencing the helper name.
   - `windowCount()` without arguments compiles to `count(*)`.
   - `lag` and `lead` strip `null` from the return type when a default value is provided, otherwise typing as nullable alongside `firstValue`, `lastValue`, and `nthValue`.

3. **Query Builder `.window(name, spec)` & Dialect Compilers**:
   - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` across all supported select builders:
     - PostgreSQL: [`PgSelectQueryBuilderBase`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts#L928) and [`PgDialect.buildSelectQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts#L405)
     - SQLite: [`SQLiteSelectQueryBuilderBase`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts#L776) and [`SQLiteDialect.buildSelectQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts#L374)
     - MySQL: [`MySqlSelectQueryBuilderBase`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts#L975) and [`MySqlDialect.buildSelectQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts#L396)
     - SingleStore: [`SingleStoreSelectQueryBuilderBase`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts#L848) and [`SingleStoreDialect.buildSelectQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts#L375)
     - Gel: [`GelSelectQueryBuilderBase`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts#L921) and [`GelDialect.buildSelectQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts#L400)
   - WINDOW definitions compile to a `WINDOW` clause placed before `ORDER BY`.
   - Named window references in `.over(name)` compile to `over <quoted_name>` without parentheses.
   - Empty `.over()` specifications append `over ()`.

4. **Testing & Verification**:
   - Added test suite in [tests/window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1rj4vq8p/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts) covering all acceptance criteria, constraints, and error conditions.
   - Verified that `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:types`, and `pnpm lint` all pass cleanly.
   - Committed all changes to branch `feat/window-functions`.
